proposal:
# Re-rank proposal 7 (loop boundary after card 214: order the Ready list under the corrective-card gate)

- Led by: the product manager seat (fresh context, pm-rerank-7). Claude seat because probes at 12:03 UTC in .mob/records/probes/2026-10-30.jsonl show Codex, Copilot, Grok and agy without usable quota.
- Before: 214 (now Done), 217, 213, 209, 210, 208, 211, 216, 212, 215, 206, 207.
- After:
  1. 209 (corrective for MD-001; startable under the gate)
  2. 210 (corrective for MD-003; startable)
  3. 208 (corrective for MD-002, F-008; startable)
  4. 211 (corrective for MD-010, records only; startable, may run in parallel)
  5. 217 (bug from F-062, a FLAG; not corrective for an open FAIL, so the gate does not start it; moved behind the cards the gate can start; its Decider question is below)
  6. 213 (paused after Done check 2; its issue says "not a corrective card for an open finding"; the gate does not start it; resumes when the gate allows)
  7. 216 (default templates carry the pending process rulings; enables 212 and 215)
  8. 212 (re-rank for every mob, runner part; depends on 208)
  9. 215 (adjustment_reviews record fields and check, D155; depends on 208)
  10. 206 (F-008, findings mirror)
  11. 207 (F-008 history rules; depends on 206)
- Next card to start: 209.
- Rationale (one line): 214 is Done and shipped without waiting for 217 (window 217-rerank-6b), so 217 no longer blocks anything and the gate cannot start it, which puts the four corrective cards first, with 217 then 213 as the first cards to run once the gate allows.

## What changed and why

- 214 leaves the list: Done (record .mob/records/214.json, retro docs/retros/card-214-2026-10-30.md).
- 217 moves from second to fifth. Window 217-rerank-6 put it second because 214's ship gate needed load-independent full-suite results. Window 217-rerank-6b removed that dependency, and the reviewer's answer was EXPOSES (a477bc6), so 217 blocks no card. CI on the shipping commit is green. The thread-pool floor (commit 5b, afa4e40) stays as a recorded mitigation until 217's Done check 3 removes or justifies it (retro). Keeping 217 first would put a card at the top that the facilitator's corrective-card gate, which starts only cards corrective for an open FAIL (MD-001, MD-002, MD-003, MD-010), would refuse, so the order would not say what runs next.
- 213 stays directly behind 217 and now sits sixth in effect only because 217 and the four corrective cards precede it. Its issue (gh issue view 213) says: "not a corrective card for an open finding" (Status Draft; source D153 L3b; it enables 205). So 213 cannot start under the gate either. It is paused after Done check 2 and no ruling is needed for it now; it resumes when the open FAILs are closed or a Decider says otherwise. Its stand-down adjustments (clean-checkout full suite, citing a pushed hash) were kept by the retro and apply on resume.
- 209, 210, 208, 211 move up to positions 1 to 4 in their existing relative order. The gate allows each, so the next start is 209.
- 216, 212, 215, 206, 207 keep their relative order and dependencies; each moves up by the cards that left or moved ahead.
- The retro's D157 (one criterion per red-green cycle) applies to whichever card starts next; the ready seat should check that the slice holds one criterion at a time before red (F-060).
- What can actually start under the gate:
  - 209, 210, 208, 211: yes (corrective for open FAILs).
  - 217: no. It cites F-062, a FLAG, not an open FAIL. Window 217-rerank-6 said this case goes to a Decider rather than bypassing the gate. A Decider is needed only if the team wants 217 to start before the four corrective cards close. This proposal does not ask for one now: 217 blocks nothing, CI is green and the floor mitigates. If a Decider is held and allows 217 early, a later re-rank moves it up.
  - 213: no (issue text above). It also needs no Decider now, because it blocks nothing, and it enables only 205 (the window experiment count), which does not stop delivery.

## Evidence considered

- .mob/records/214.json and docs/retros/card-214-2026-10-30.md: 214 Done, CI run 41052829472 green, pre-ship gate 917bfc6, review a477bc6 (EXPOSES, one medium fix, fixed in d18194c), floor kept until 217, D157 now applies, F-062 open.
- Windows 217-rerank-6 and 217-rerank-6b (.mob/records/decisions/): the open point that 217 may be refused by the gate and goes to a Decider; 6b ended the hold of 214 on 217 and left the corrective-card gate unchanged.
- gh issue view 213: not a corrective card; Status Draft; paused after Done check 2.
- Open FAILs from the latest audit tick, as given by the facilitator: MD-001, MD-002, MD-003, MD-010 (F-058 closed; F-056's card is Done and the auditor closes it). I did not read .mob/audits/last.json myself (tick files are not committed); the corrective-card mapping of 209, 210, 208, 211 follows re-rank note 2026-10-30-6 and the facilitator's facts.
- Re-rank note 2026-10-30-6 for the before order.
- Retro cost evidence: 83 minutes from issue to first red against 24 on card 205, with windows a likely contributor, so this proposal asks for one poll and no Decider.

## Neither a one-way door nor a standing-rule change

Reversible: it is a Rank order for one boundary, and any card can be moved again by a later window (217 can move up the moment a Decider allows it or the FAILs close). It applies the existing corrective-card gate as written and does not exempt 217 or 213 from it. No checker, template or standing rule changes.

## Window rule

Every declared role polled, i.e. architect, QA engineer, backend developer, independent reviewer (audit lens), delivery lead, product manager (signoff); silence is not consent (F-054). The product manager is the proposer. Category: loop-boundary re-rank (D148, D153). Seats should name the evidence they read in each reply (retro tune).
